name: Awesomesauce Blocks
author: Ѧwesomə Pøssum ❤️

sections.description:
Bring a splash of creativity to your WordPress site with Awesomesauce Blocks! Transform your content with unique blocks that defy the ordinary. From dazzling text effects and mesmerizing particle animations to cutting-edge data blocks, this plugin is your gateway to a website that stands out. 🚀✨

Features:
– CSS Text Effects: Ultra-lightweight effects using just HTML and CSS! Create captivating text animations effortlessly.
– JS Text Effects: From the Matrix effect to text shuffling and typewriter animations, explore a range of dynamic text effects.
– Particle Effects: Add visual flair with effects like Bokeh, Crystals, Snow, Space travel and more.
– Clocks: Display time with style using Analog, Neon, Text and other innovative clock designs.
– Data Blocks: Showcase information with unique blocks for Barcode, Braille, Maxi code, Morse code and QR code.

JavaScript Libraries

The non-minified versions of all JavaScript library files used in Awesomesauce Blocks are publicly available on GitHub: Awesomesauce Blocks GitHub Repository. Additionally, the minified JS files included in the plugin contain comments with links to their original, non-minified versions for reference.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Awesomesauce Blocks.
  4. Click Install Now and activate the plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
1. How do I use Awesomesauce Blocks?

  • Once activated, enter the WordPress left admin menu’s Awesomesauce menupoint -> Add New.
  • There you’ll find a range of exciting blocks. Choose one of them and configure its settings.
  • When the block is done, press Save. Copy the block’s shortcode from the right sidebar, and paste it into one of your WordPress pages or posts.

2. Where can I get support?

For any questions or support, please visit our support page.

3. Where is the documentation?

You can reach the documentation on this link.
